en.title: Newton's Beautiful Sequence
en.description:
Sort each non-empty contiguous subarray of the original array independently. After sorting, the subarray's contribution increases by 1 for each pair of adjacent elements whose difference is greater than 1; a subarray of length 1 also contributes 1. Output the total contribution of all subarrays modulo 10^9+7.

The explicit standard input/output format and supplementary constraints of this site belong to the definition of the online version and do not pose as the original source constraints.
en.input: The input is N followed by N integers. This site adopts the constraints listed separately in the statement, 1≤N≤1000 and 1≤sequence[i]≤N; the text of the main constraint line is run together, so this site organizes it according to this readable constraint.
en.explanation: Fix the left endpoint and extend the right endpoint step by step, maintaining a bitset of the values seen. When inserting a new value, find its predecessor and successor, and update the number of adjacent value pairs with a gap greater than 1; a single-element subarray counts an extra 1.
